# PixelLauncherEnhanced reference

Author: Mahmud0808 and the upstream contributors.

Repository: https://github.com/Mahmud0808/PixelLauncherEnhanced

Source revision: `cdf53e18ec36c46c1686ce498f7e657642681ecc`.

Original file:
`app/src/main/java/com/drdisagree/pixellauncherenhanced/xposed/mods/IconGlass.kt`.

`IconGlass.kt` is an unmodified reference copy. CherryPick adapts its
`FloatingGlassBackground` integration principle in `IconGlassHook.kt` with its own
ColorOS material renderer and source tracking. This reference file is outside the
Android source set and is not compiled into CherryPick.
